page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. No margin notes. The running head is at the top right, the page number at the top left, and the catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.p: exheredandi sunt, ne testamentum a-gnascendo rumpant.
Siue quæ neptis.) Non enim nepotis appellatione nominatim videbatur in stitui: ac propterea tanquam præteri-ta testamentum rupisset.

In decem mensibus.) Nam decimo mense legitime hominem gigni, Decemviri duodecim in Tabulis caverunt: uti Gellius lib.3.cap.16. scribit, ubi verba hæc ex M. Varronis Testamento prodit: Si quis mihi filius, unus, pluresve in decem mensibus gignūtur, ň, si erūt ὄνοι λύϱας[?], exheredes sunto. Similēq; formulam videmus in L.ult.C.hoc tit. & L.ult.D.de fideic.libert.
Sinon exprimat.) Sed simpliciter sub-stitutionis vulgaris formula utens, ita scribat, Si heres non erit.
Concipi possit.) Potest autem hic solus concipi, intellígiq,[?] si testatore vivo moriatur: ut in Paraphrasi docuimus.
Gallus sic induxit.) Prima enunciatio: Olim Iurisconsulti heredum instituendorum formulas conscribebant.

page.notes: Running head is in a decorative face and could not be read. Line break "Decemui / ri" has no printed hyphen, so it is written whole as Decemviri. The Greek phrase "ὄνοι λύϱας" is doubtful, and the abbreviated mark after "ň," is unclear. "intellígiq," is uncertain. The paragraph "Partitio § Gallus." is treated as a level-2 heading. The catchword "Siue" is at the bottom right.
